mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM template_maker i WHERE i.template_id = #{templateId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM maker m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.name = i.name)
SELECT i.name AS name FROM template_maker i JOIN maker m ON m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.name = i.name WHERE i.template_id = #{templateId} ORDER BY i.template_maker_id
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(maker_id), 0) FROM maker WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO maker (user_id, name, description) SELECT #{userId}, i.name, i.description FROM template_maker i WHERE i.template_id = #{templateId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM maker m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.name = i.name)

INSERT INTO thumbnail_image (user_id, target_type, target_id, file_path, original_name, file_size) SELECT #{userId}, 'MAKER', m.maker_id, t.file_path, t.original_name, t.file_size FROM template_maker i JOIN maker m ON m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.name = i.name JOIN thumbnail_image t ON t.target_type = 'TEMPLATE_MAKER' AND t.target_id = i.template_maker_id WHERE i.template_id = #{templateId} AND m.maker_id > #{maxItemId}
